evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 declares render=0.0 and constraints=0.0 gates; tools/score.py:40-48 zeroes reward unless every gate score > 0 and skips scored dims otherwise. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation="all_pass" (line 15) with one binary criterion. Render (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:18-24, hro_gate_render): 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out ... the correct password for a seeded Recruiter (prefer Rafael Costa) then signs in and shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> auth leg with positive control (render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). Constraints (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:18-24, hro_gate_shared): Recruiter creates a job and a candidate through ordinary UI, then an independent empty browser context signed in as the Observer must find the same job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' -> real server-backing leg with independent-context readback, satisfying REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. Gate setup only uses publicly required features (instruction.md:3,17; hireops_rules.md:16-18,27-31: recruiters open jobs with title/team/hiring manager/places 1-50, add candidates with name/email/source; Observer reads the board). EVERY SCORED PROMPT CARRIES A HARD-ZEROING IN-DIMENSION GATE. functional/prompt.md:9-13 restates the same Recruiter-create + Observer independent-context readback and says 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' (all 43 functional criteria are type binary: grep count 43/43). polish/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives binary0 throughout' (all 5 polish criteria binary). visual/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' (all 5 visual criteria likert points=5 with 1-anchor = total failure). None assigns partial credit on gate failure; each then requires independent scoring after the gate passes. NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. grep -i origin over tests/, instruction.md and environment/instructions finds only functional judge.toml:200 (unrelated stale-move wording); no gate or prompt asks for same-origin, and instruction.md:13 explicitly allows CDN fonts/scripts. The 'serve the UI as well as the API from that one process' line is a public launch requirement in the brief, not a gate demand. Adversarial probes: (a) static shell / seeded-JSON mock with fake login -> fails constraints gate (new job+card absent in independent context) and every in-dimension gate; (b) localStorage-only save -> fails independent-context readback; (c) no-auth app that shows data without sign-in -> cannot satisfy 'incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out' followed by a valid sign-in; (d) app persisting only in memory -> passes gates but is caught by functional hro_restart (correctly kept out of the gate per policy 'keep unrelated difficulty in scored outcomes'); (e) conforming alternative with different routes/labels, CDN assets, cross-origin API calls or a team field the scored gate setup does not mention -> gates use intent-based discovery ('Discover routes and controls by intent'), allow another working staff account in place of Aud, and the judge may fill extra required fields, so I found no conforming app that the gate wording would wrongly zero. NOTES (not defects for this row): the task's render gate drops the template's 'no protected data is visible before sign-in' leg; anonymous protection is instead graded in functional hro_anonymous (judge.toml:185-192, replays refused with 401 and no workspace data). Constraints gate wording 'exactly one card' vs scored gate 'the same candidate card' is a small wording drift with no practical scoring conflict. The visual claim that raw Likert 1 normalizes to zero depends on RewardKit's likert normalization, which is not in the frozen task and was not verified here (shared harness, row 41 domain). RISK: raw-evidence-index scope states full configured grading, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle scores are absent; the scripted golden used API fixture setup, so no configured judge run shows the golden passing either gate or a weak app being zeroed by the gates or the in-dimension gates. The source-level verdict is Pass; the runtime behavior is NOT EXERCISED.
